QuestInfo.name: The Ariant Rebel
QuestInfo.0: Duped by the sisters, and with no leads on Phantom, the duo found themselves with no path to the Goddess Teardrop. The only hope they had was their new friend #b#p2420007##k, who had returned to the Sand Bandit's hideout in #bthe eastern deserted house in #m322000000##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p2400005# and #p2400006# visited the Sand Bandit's hideout to find #p2420007#, but quickly realized they had stumbled on to the Sand Bandit base right before their attack on the Queen's palace! With the Goddess Teardrop out of reach, they decided the best thing to do would be to help their new friends.
QuestInfo.2: Just like everybody else they meet, the Sand Bandits expected a lot from Alpha and Beta before they could be trusted. They duo would have to pass a test... but what kind?

1.0: S-sorry, I didn't think the boss would be so mad... But hey, all you gotta do is pass a little test!
1.1: You should talk to Sejan. He's way less crazy than Eleska.
